seoTitle: How to Share TradingView Charts and Grant Access
metaDescription: Learn how to share TradingView charts using links, publish ideas, and understand the difference between sharing a chart and granting account access.
intro: Sharing a chart with a friend or client on TradingView is different from granting someone access to your actual account, and mixing the two up can create confusion or security risks. This guide covers the correct ways to share charts, publish ideas, and control who can see what.

steps.heading: Share a chart using a link
steps.body: TradingView lets you generate a shareable link for your current chart setup so others can view it without logging into your account.

steps.heading: Publish an idea publicly or privately
steps.body: Use TradingView's publish feature to post an analysis idea either to the public community or restricted to specific viewers, depending on your privacy needs.

steps.heading: Understand chart sharing vs account access
steps.body: Sharing a chart link only shows your setup; it does not give the other person any control over your account, watchlists, or settings.

steps.heading: Control privacy and visibility settings
steps.body: Review your sharing and publishing settings to decide whether your charts and ideas are visible to everyone or only people you choose.

steps.heading: Follow good sharing practices
steps.body: Avoid sharing sensitive account details, and use published or shared links rather than login credentials when collaborating with others.

faq.question: Does sharing a chart give someone access to my account?
faq.answer: No, sharing a chart link only shows the chart's current view — it doesn't grant login access or control over your TradingView account.

faq.question: Can I make a shared chart link private?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView provides privacy options so shared links or published ideas can be restricted rather than fully public.

faq.question: How do I share a chart with a mentor for feedback?
faq.answer: Generate a share link for your current chart setup and send it directly, or publish it privately if you don't want it visible to the wider community.

faq.question: Is there a way to grant someone actual account access?
faq.answer: TradingView doesn't support handing over account login access safely; instead, use chart links or published ideas for collaboration.
